`microsToUsd2dp` is defined in `web/src/lib/redis/micro-dollars.ts` and used in four other files. I found them with a text search of the repo, skipping `node_modules`, `.git` and `.next`.

- **`web/src/lib/admin/admin-shape.ts`** imports it and calls it three times, for `costAllTime2dp`, `cost2dp` and `totalSpend2dp`.
- **`web/src/lib/leaderboard/window-sums-batch.ts`** imports it and calls it once, for `cost2dp`.
- **`web/src/lib/leaderboard/assemble-board.ts`** imports it and calls it when the metric is `"cost"`.
- **`web/test/leaderboard/micro-dollars.test.ts`** is the test file. It checks rounding at the cent, zero, sub-cent values and the half-cent case, and a round trip through `costUsdStringToMicros`.

web/src/lib/leaderboard/window-sums-batch.ts
web/src/lib/leaderboard/assemble-board.ts
web/test/leaderboard/micro-dollars.test.ts
</files>
